# Redfin

> Technology-powered real estate platform for searching homes and rentals, connecting with agents, and exploring mortgage and selling services.

Redfin combines home search, rental discovery, brokerage services, mortgage tools, and local market data across the United States. Its site includes listing search, agent matching, home-selling resources, rental applications, and market insights for buyers, sellers, renters, and homeowners.

## Core Search
- [Redfin Home Search](https://www.redfin.com): Main search experience for homes for sale, rentals, agents, and mortgage-related services.
- [Homes for Sale](https://www.redfin.com/buy-a-home): Entry point for buying a home with search tools, tours, and offer support.
- [Apartments for Rent](https://www.redfin.com/rentals): Rental search for apartments, houses, condos, and townhomes across U.S. markets.
- [Find an Agent](https://www.redfin.com/real-estate-agents): Directory for connecting with local Redfin agents and partner agents.
- [Mortgage Rates](https://www.redfin.com/mortgage-rates): Current mortgage rate information and financing-related guidance for homebuyers.
- [Home Value Estimator](https://www.redfin.com/what-is-my-home-worth): Estimate a home's value using Redfin pricing and market data.

## Buying a Home
- [Buy a Home](https://www.redfin.com/buy-a-home): Overview of Redfin's homebuying process, tools, and agent support.
- [How to Buy a House](https://www.redfin.com/guides/how-to-buy-a-house): Step-by-step guide to buying a home, from search to closing.
- [First-Time Home Buyer Guide](https://www.redfin.com/guides/first-time-home-buyer): Introductory guidance for buyers navigating financing, offers, and closing.
- [Open Book](https://www.redfin.com/openbook): Explore homes sold nearby and comparable property details for research.
- [Book a Home Tour](https://www.redfin.com/tour): Schedule in-person or virtual tours for eligible listings.
- [Making an Offer](https://www.redfin.com/guides/making-an-offer): Guidance on preparing and submitting competitive home offers.

## Selling a Home
- [Sell a Home](https://www.redfin.com/sell-a-home): Overview of Redfin's home-selling services, pricing, and agent support.
- [How Much Can I Sell My House For](https://www.redfin.com/sell-my-house): Seller-focused valuation and pricing guidance for listing a home.
- [Home Selling Guide](https://www.redfin.com/guides/home-selling): Guide to preparing, pricing, listing, and closing a home sale.
- [Redfin Full Service](https://www.redfin.com/full-service): Information about full-service listing support from Redfin agents.
- [Redfin Concierge](https://www.redfin.com/concierge): Service details for home improvements and preparation before listing.
- [Compare Listing Fees](https://www.redfin.com/why-sell-with-redfin): Explanation of Redfin selling fees and service model.

## Rentals
- [Rentals](https://www.redfin.com/rentals): Main rental search for apartments and homes available for lease.
- [Apartments for Rent Near Me](https://www.redfin.com/apartments-for-rent-near-me): Location-based apartment rental discovery across supported markets.
- [Houses for Rent Near Me](https://www.redfin.com/houses-for-rent-near-me): Search page for single-family rental homes by area.
- [Cheap Apartments for Rent Near Me](https://www.redfin.com/cheap-apartments-for-rent-near-me): Rental search focused on lower-cost apartment listings.
- [Pet Friendly Apartments for Rent Near Me](https://www.redfin.com/pet-friendly-apartments-for-rent-near-me): Search for rentals that allow pets.
- [Rental Application](https://www.redfin.com/rental-application): Apply to participating rental listings through Redfin's application workflow.

## Mortgage and Affordability
- [Mortgage](https://www.redfin.com/mortgage): Mortgage overview, financing options, and related home loan resources.
- [Mortgage Rates](https://www.redfin.com/mortgage-rates): Daily mortgage rate information and trend context for borrowers.
- [Mortgage Calculator](https://www.redfin.com/mortgage-calculator): Estimate monthly payments based on price, down payment, taxes, and insurance.
- [Affordability Calculator](https://www.redfin.com/how-much-house-can-i-afford): Estimate how much home you may be able to afford.
- [Refinance Calculator](https://www.redfin.com/refinance-calculator): Evaluate potential refinance payments and savings scenarios.
- [Down Payment Calculator](https://www.redfin.com/down-payment-assistance): Resource area for down payment planning and assistance information.

## Home Values and Market Data
- [What Is My Home Worth](https://www.redfin.com/what-is-my-home-worth): Home value estimate tool for owners researching current market value.
- [Housing Market News](https://www.redfin.com/news/housing-market-news): Redfin's market reporting and commentary on housing trends.
- [Housing Market Data Center](https://www.redfin.com/news/data-center): Central hub for Redfin housing market data and reports.
- [Migration Data](https://www.redfin.com/news/data-center/migration): Data on where homebuyers are moving to and from.
- [Open Book](https://www.redfin.com/openbook): Sold-home and comparable-sales lookup for neighborhood market research.
- [Home Price Index](https://www.redfin.com/news/data-center/home-price-index): Redfin's home price trend data and index reporting.

## Guides and Resources
- [Redfin Guides](https://www.redfin.com/guides): Collection of educational guides for buying, selling, renting, and financing.
- [Homebuying Guide](https://www.redfin.com/guides/homebuying): Educational resource covering the home purchase process.
- [Home Selling Guide](https://www.redfin.com/guides/home-selling): Educational resource for preparing and listing a home for sale.
- [Renting Guide](https://www.redfin.com/guides/renting): Guidance for renters searching, applying, and moving into a rental.
- [Escrow Guide](https://www.redfin.com/guides/escrow): Explanation of escrow and closing steps in a real estate transaction.
- [Closing Costs Guide](https://www.redfin.com/guides/closing-costs): Overview of common closing costs for buyers and sellers.

## Agents and Brokerage
- [Real Estate Agents](https://www.redfin.com/real-estate-agents): Search and browse local agents serving Redfin markets.
- [Why Redfin Agents](https://www.redfin.com/why-redfin): Overview of Redfin's agent model and customer service approach.
- [Partner Program](https://www.redfin.com/partner-program): Information about Redfin's partner agent network and referrals.
- [Find Listing Agents](https://www.redfin.com/real-estate-agents/listing-agent): Browse agents focused on helping homeowners sell properties.
- [Find Buyer's Agents](https://www.redfin.com/real-estate-agents/buyers-agent): Browse agents focused on helping homebuyers tour and purchase homes.
- [Redfin Careers](https://www.redfin.com/careers): Careers information for agents, corporate roles, and other positions.

## News and Company
- [Redfin News](https://www.redfin.com/news): Company news, housing analysis, research, and press updates.
- [Press Center](https://www.redfin.com/news/press): Official press releases and media announcements from Redfin.
- [Research Reports](https://www.redfin.com/news/category/research): Housing research articles and data-driven market analysis.
- [About Redfin](https://www.redfin.com/about): Company background, mission, and business overview.
- [Contact Redfin](https://www.redfin.com/contact-us): Customer support and contact options for Redfin services.
- [Help Center](https://www.redfin.com/resources): Support resources and answers to common questions.
